 Where to watch Jamie Dornan, Anthony Mackie in ‘12 12 12’ series for free 
 By 
 Angela Tricarico 
 Published 
 Nov. 12, 2026, 5:15 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Apple TV 
 Page Six may be compensated and/or receive an affiliate commission if you click or buy through our links. Featured pricing is subject to change.
 With this heist, timing is everything. 
 Apple TV’s latest original, “12 12 12,” premieres tomorrow, Nov. 13, exclusively on the streamer .
 The heist thriller depicts three stages of a high-stakes heist in Zurich, Switzerland and follows both the team behind the heist and the agents pursuing them. 
 Watch '12 12 12' for free
 When: Nov. 13
 How to watch for free: Apple TV (one-week free trial)
 TV Channel: Streaming exclusive
 The title refers to the 12-month planning period before the heist, 12 hours during the heist itself and 12 days after the heist. 
 When does ’12 12 12′ come out on Apple TV?
 “12 12 12” premieres Friday, Nov. 13 with two episodes.
 Apple TV has not officially confirmed a release time for episodes of “12 12 12,” but the streamer will often release new episodes of original series the night before their listed premiere date. In the case of “12 12 12,” you’ll likely be able to stream new episodes as early as 9:00 p.m. ET on Thursday nights going forward.
 How to watch ’12 12 12′ for free on Apple TV
 “12 12 12” is airing exclusively on Apple TV , so you’ll need a subscription to watch the show.
 Apple TV offers a seven-day free trial for users, so you’ll be able to watch two weeks of doubleheaders before $12.99/month payments kick in.
 TRY APPLE TV FOR FREE 
 Amazon Prime members can also subscribe to Apple TV directly through Prime Video . It costs the same monthly price and also includes a seven-day free trial, but allows you to stream Apple’s content inside the Prime Video app.
 ’12 12 12′ series cast
 Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan lead the cast of “12 12 12.” Mackie plays Jack Strickland, a disgraced FBI agent haunted by a past heist who pursues the crew across Europe, while Dornan is Paul Galvin, an American career criminal trying to start over before he’s pulled into another high-stakes heist. 
 Apple TV 
 Jack Kesy, Kali Reis, Ólafur Darri Ólafsson, Agathe Rousselle, Sallie Harmsen and Patrick Fabian round out the cast.
 ’12 12 12′ episode guide
 “12 12 12” will have eight episodes. Check out the official Friday release dates for every episode below, but remember, they may be available to stream around 9:00 p.m. ET the night before the listed date.
 Episode 1: “All for a F**king Betamax, Dad” – Nov. 13
 Episode 2: “I Want My Halo Back” – Nov. 13
 Episode 3: “Einfach Obergeil” – Nov. 20
 Episode 4: “That’s How You Make a Boy Baby” – Nov. 27
 Episode 5: “One for the Money, Two for the Show” – Dec. 4
 Episode 6: “I Know Who You Are” – Dec. 11
 Episode 7: “You’re One of Us, Maybe You Always Were” – Dec. 18
 Episode 8: “The Banks Must Pay” – Dec. 25
